about.heading: About FRINIT
about.lead: For more than fifteen years we have helped the world's brands source and manufacture slippers and caps from China — from the very first sketch to the final container.
paragraphs: FRINIT is a China-based sourcing and manufacturing partner with over fifteen years' experience helping international brands bring slippers and caps to market. From the first sketch to the final container, we act as the trusted extension of your own team on the ground.

Footwear is where we shine. We specialise in slippers — from lightweight summer beach sandals to plush winter fur slippers — and in caps, from baseball caps and wide-brim sun hats to knit beanies. Over the years we have built a carefully vetted network of 20+ partner factories in footwear and caps, matched precisely to each brief.

Quality is never left to chance. Our inspectors carry out factory audits, in-line checks and pre-shipment inspections to recognised AQL standards, and we engage third-party laboratories wherever testing is called for — slip resistance, phthalates, colour-fastness and more. You can be certain that what leaves the factory is exactly what you approved.

Our in-house design team keeps pace with trends across European and global markets, and develops exclusive slipper and cap styles tailored to your brand. Whether you supply your own artwork or brief us to create from scratch, we turn ideas into production-ready products through OEM and ODM.

Our clients span the USA, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, from established retailers to fast-growing independent labels. Many have worked with us for the better part of a decade — the clearest proof of the relationships we build on trust and consistency.

We welcome orders against your own designs and branding, and we hold to one simple principle: Credit and Honesty. It is how we have earned a strong reputation and lasting partnerships across the industry.
